payload.posture: Read Mark 10:32–34 as one movement in the resurrection, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states going toward Jerusalem, Jesus names leaders, Gentiles, mockery, abuse, death, and rising after three days. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of the resurrection.
